facts.text: The resort overlooks a bay and a 100-metre sandy beach on Kea, a Cycladic island.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking one of Greece's most picturesque bays and a 100-metre sandy beach, our Cycladic Island resort reconnects guests with pure nature

facts.text: Kea is the closest Cycladic island to Athens.
facts.excerpt: Kéa is the closest Cycladic island to Athens: just 45 minutes away by speedboat, or a thrilling 15-minute helicopter ride

facts.text: A 15-minute private helicopter flight from Athens International Airport lands at the resort's helipad.
facts.excerpt: take a 15-minute private helicopter flight from Athens International Airport, touching down at the resort's helipad

facts.text: The resort's speedboat reaches the resort's pier in 45 minutes from Athens Lavrio Port.
facts.excerpt: Cruise across the Aegean in our speedboat, reaching our resort’s pier in just 45 minutes from Athens Lavrio Port.

facts.text: Ferry services and private transfers between Athens and Kea are currently unavailable at night.
facts.excerpt: ferry services and private transfers between Athens and Kéa Island are currently unavailable at night

facts.text: All transfer options are subject to weather conditions.
facts.excerpt: All transfer options are subject to weather conditions. In the event of adverse weather, transfers may be delayed or rescheduled.

facts.text: The resort is pet-friendly, with pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies.
facts.excerpt: We can cater to your canine companion with pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies.

facts.text: Pools and windows frame Aegean views, with soaring atriums, open archways and lofty ceilings.
facts.excerpt: Pools and windows frame Aegean vistas; soaring atriums, open archways and lofty ceilings signal relaxed grandeur.

facts.text: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.

facts.text: The resort sits on its own naturally formed peninsula with panoramic views across the Aegean.
facts.excerpt: sits on its own naturally-formed peninsula with panoramic views across the Aegean

facts.text: The resort was designed by architect John Heah.
facts.excerpt: Imagined by veteran resort architect John Heah

facts.text: The stone guests see is stone found on the peninsula, excavated and repurposed.
facts.excerpt: each and every stone guests see is the stone found on the peninsula, excavated and repurposed to keep the area's natural materials intact

facts.text: Each room is a private villa suite set into the hillside, with a private courtyard entrance and its own infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Each room is its own private villa suite, self-contained and set into the hillside inside its own high-ceilinged box-like free-standing structure, with private courtyard entrances and individual 26-foot infinity pools

facts.text: Each villa is decorated with original art from emerging Greek artists.
facts.excerpt: Each is decorated with original art from emerging Greek artists

facts.text: The spa was created with wellness brand Subtle Energies.
facts.excerpt: For Kea, the group worked with Subtle Energies, a wellness brand founded by Ayurveda Practitioner and Clinical Aromatherapist Farida Irani

facts.text: The spa spans three floors with an indoor-outdoor pool, outdoor relaxation areas, and steam and sauna rooms.
facts.excerpt: with spaces over three floors with an indoor-outdoor pool, spacious treatment rooms, outdoor relaxation areas, and steam and sauna rooms

facts.text: Bond Beach Club is a restaurant with its feet in the sand, shaded by ancient trees.
facts.excerpt: Bond Beach Club, a gorgeously untouched restaurant with its feet in the sand, shaded by ancient trees

facts.text: The wine list has over 200 labels, around 85% of them Greek.
facts.excerpt: Marouli has sourced over 200 labels, and around 85% are Greek, including many small-batch wines from little-known vineyards

facts.text: Kea is surrounded by several shipwrecks, including the Britannic, and the resort has its own dive center.
facts.excerpt: Kea is surrounded by several shipwrecks, including that of the Britannic, the sister ship to the Titanic

facts.text: The kids club and the Club One sports center sit in the valley, with a tennis court, half basketball court and bikes for hire.
facts.excerpt: there is a tennis court, half basketball court, games consoles, and bikes for hire

facts.text: In 2025 the resort featured in Travel + Leisure's It List and the Conde Nast Hot List.
facts.excerpt: In 2025, we featured in Travel + Leisure’s It List and the Condé Nast Hot List

contradictions.note: p1 says speedboat 45 minutes from Lavrio; p2 says private speedboat 30 minutes and says helicopter not currently offered
